/.title: When two problems need attention at once
paragraphs: After a crash, your car may be sitting in a tow yard while you’re also trying to arrange follow-up care. Start a short list with the next appointment, where the car is and who has already called you. Include any letter that gives you a response date. If a family member is making calls for you, have them record which office or insurer they reached and what it asked for. That gives Howard a starting point for the first conversation and helps identify the issue that needs attention first.
/.linkLabel: See what to expect after you call

/contact.title: What to tell us in your first message
paragraphs: Start with the date and city of the incident, how you were hurt and how we can reach you. Mention the most immediate issue, such as an insurance offer with a deadline, a missing collision report or a work restriction. If you are contacting us for someone else, explain your relationship and whether they can join the conversation.

You can keep the first message brief. Have the original letter or report number nearby if you have it. When you speak with the office, ask how to share records securely and which pages would help with the next conversation.

/attorney.title: Questions to ask Howard before hiring him
paragraphs: Ask who will review a new insurance letter, how you’ll receive updates while records are pending and who will explain the options if an offer comes in. If you’ve already talked with another firm, describe what you still need clarified. Howard’s accounting background may be particularly relevant when the claim involves irregular income or several medical balances. Ask how he would organize those records and what he would need from you to assess them.
/attorney.linkLabel: See how the office reviews an injury claim

/about.title: How to compare two consultations
paragraphs: Write down what each lawyer identified as the next decision. Did they ask for the report, the policy language, the treatment record or something else? Then ask how they would keep you informed while that record is being obtained. A useful consultation should give you a clear question to answer and a way to bring new information into the conversation. Save those notes with any fee agreement you receive so you can compare the actual scope of work.
/about.linkLabel: See how the claim review begins

/about/our-difference.title: How one missing record can change the next step
paragraphs: Suppose an insurer accepts that the cars collided but questions why you missed work. A repair estimate and a picture of the intersection may already be in the file. The missing pieces could be the work restriction and a schedule showing the missed shifts. A more focused request starts with the issue under review and names the record that could help answer it. Ask what evidence would change the next decision in your own case.
/about/our-difference.linkLabel: See how records support a claim estimate

/about/what-to-expect.title: Keep track of the person who has the next task
paragraphs: After an update, write down the outstanding item and who can get it. An employer may be confirming missed shifts, an insurer may be checking coverage, and a medical office may be preparing a record from a follow-up visit. Set a date to check back on each. When someone finishes a task, record what came in and whether it answers the original question. That makes the next call useful even if several parts of the claim are still moving.
/about/what-to-expect.linkLabel: Read questions people ask during a case

/about/zero-fee-guarantee.title: What to ask about the fee agreement
paragraphs: Ask the office to walk through an example of how money would be distributed. Find the provisions that explain the attorney fee, case expenses and which amounts are deducted before you receive payment. Ask how expenses are treated if the case closes without a recovery. If the case moves into litigation, ask whether that changes the terms. Keep a copy of the signed agreement with any written explanation of its terms.
/about/zero-fee-guarantee.linkLabel: Read about gross recovery and the amount a client receives

/results.title: Read each result with three questions in mind
paragraphs: First ask what the parties disputed. Then look for the record that helped answer that question. Finally, identify what the outcome actually describes. A trial verdict, an appeals court ruling and a settlement tell you different things about a case. If you are considering your own claim, write down which facts are still missing before drawing a parallel. A shared injury label can conceal very different treatment, time away from work and available insurance.
/results.linkLabel: See what affects the value of an injury claim

/case-value-calculator.title: How to make a second estimate useful
paragraphs: Save the assumptions and date of your first estimate. If you update it after receiving a medical bill, work restriction or policy letter, note exactly what changed. Keep an estimate based on confirmed records separate from any future costs you are still trying to document. Compare the two versions to see which assumption has the biggest effect. That gives you a specific question to take into a consultation or raise with the source of the estimate.
/case-value-calculator.linkLabel: Read the case value and settlement FAQ

/blogs.title: Follow one question through the article library
paragraphs: If you’re dealing with a crash, start with the guide that answers the immediate question. Someone waiting on a police record needs a different article from someone comparing a repair estimate or reviewing a settlement release. Keep the relevant claim number and document open while you read. When a topic raises a separate question about coverage, deadlines or the evidence needed to assign fault, follow the related guide from there.

/es.title: Cuando hay dos problemas urgentes a la vez
paragraphs: Después de un choque, el auto puede estar en un depósito mientras usted organiza su atención médica. Anote la próxima cita, dónde está el auto, quién se ha comunicado con usted y cualquier fecha límite indicada por escrito. Si un familiar está haciendo llamadas, pídale que anote a quién llamó y qué le pidieron.
/es.linkLabel: Vea qué esperar después de llamar (en inglés)

/ko.title: 두 가지 문제가 동시에 생겼을 때
paragraphs: 사고 뒤 차량은 견인 보관소에 있고 추가 진료도 잡아야 할 수 있습니다. 다음 진료일, 차량 위치, 연락해 온 기관이나 보험사, 서류에 적힌 회신 날짜를 한곳에 적어 두세요. 가족이 대신 전화한다면 어디에 연락했고 어떤 요청을 받았는지도 메모해 달라고 하세요.

/es/contact.title: Qué incluir en el primer mensaje
paragraphs: Indique la fecha y ciudad del incidente, cómo se lesionó y cómo podemos contactarle. Mencione lo más urgente, como una oferta con fecha de respuesta o un informe pendiente. Si escribe por otra persona, diga cuál es su relación y si esa persona puede participar en la llamada. Puede preguntar después cómo enviar documentos de forma segura.
/es/contact.linkLabel: Prepárese para la primera conversación (en inglés)

/ko/contact.title: 첫 문의에 포함할 내용
paragraphs: 사고 날짜와 도시, 다친 경위, 연락 가능한 방법을 알려 주세요. 답변 기한이 있는 제안이나 아직 받지 못한 보고서처럼 급한 문제도 언급해 주세요. 다른 사람을 대신해 문의한다면 그분과의 관계와 함께 통화할 수 있는지도 알려 주세요. 민감한 서류는 안전한 전달 방법을 먼저 확인하세요.

/es/attorney.title: Qué preguntarle a Howard antes de contratarlo
paragraphs: Pregunte quién revisará una nueva carta del seguro, cómo recibirá novedades y quién le explicará sus opciones al llegar una oferta. Si sus ingresos varían o hay varios saldos médicos, pida que le indiquen cómo organizar esos registros y qué documentos necesitan para evaluarlos.
/es/attorney.linkLabel: Vea cómo se revisa un reclamo (en inglés)

/ko/attorney.title: 선임 전에 Howard에게 물어볼 질문
paragraphs: 보험사에서 새 서류가 오면 누가 검토하는지, 진행 상황을 어떤 방식으로 알려 주는지, 합의 제안을 받으면 누가 선택지를 설명하는지 물어보세요. 소득이 일정하지 않거나 의료비 잔액이 여러 개라면 어떻게 정리하고 어떤 자료를 준비해야 하는지도 확인하세요.

/es/about.title: Cómo comparar dos consultas
paragraphs: Anote qué decisión considera prioritaria cada abogado. Quizá falte un informe, una cláusula de la póliza o un registro médico específico. Pregunte cómo le mantendrán al tanto mientras se obtiene ese documento. Guarde sus notas con los convenios de honorarios para comparar el trabajo que realmente se ofrece.
/es/about.linkLabel: Vea cómo se inicia la revisión del caso (en inglés)

/ko/about.title: 두 곳에서 상담받았다면 비교할 내용
paragraphs: 각 변호사가 무엇을 먼저 확인하자고 했는지 적어 보세요. 보고서, 보험 약관, 특정 진료 기록 중 어떤 자료가 필요한지, 그 자료를 받는 동안 진행 상황을 어떻게 알려 주는지도 물어보세요. 상담 메모와 계약서를 함께 두면 실제 업무 범위를 비교하기 쉽습니다.

/es/results.title: Tres preguntas al leer un resultado
paragraphs: Identifique qué discutían las partes, qué documento ayudó a aclararlo y qué resolvió el asunto. Un veredicto, una decisión de apelación y un acuerdo describen etapas distintas. Antes de comparar su situación, anote qué datos le faltan sobre su tratamiento, el tiempo fuera del trabajo y el seguro disponible.
/es/results.linkLabel: Vea qué influye en el valor de un reclamo

/ko/results.title: 사건 결과를 읽을 때 확인할 세 가지
paragraphs: 당사자들이 무엇을 다퉜는지, 어떤 자료가 그 쟁점을 설명했는지, 결과가 무엇을 뜻하는지 확인하세요. 배심원 평결, 항소심 판결, 합의는 사건의 서로 다른 과정을 보여 줍니다. 본인 사건과 비교하기 전에 치료와 결근, 보험에 관해 아직 모르는 사실을 적어 보세요.
/ko/results.linkLabel: 상해 청구 가치에 영향을 주는 요소 보기

/es/case-value-calculator.title: Cómo comparar dos estimaciones
paragraphs: Guarde la fecha y los supuestos de la primera estimación. Si la actualiza al recibir una factura o una carta, anote qué dato cambió. Separe los importes que cuentan con respaldo de los costos futuros pendientes de documentar. Así puede preguntar por el dato que más influye en el resultado.
/es/case-value-calculator.linkLabel: Lea las preguntas sobre acuerdos y valor (en inglés)

/ko/case-value-calculator.title: 두 번의 추정치를 비교하는 방법
paragraphs: 첫 추정치를 계산한 날짜와 전제 조건을 저장해 두세요. 새 청구서나 보험사 서류를 받아 다시 계산했다면 어느 입력값이 바뀌었는지 적으세요. 자료로 확인한 금액과 아직 근거를 모으고 있는 미래 비용을 구분하면 어떤 값이 결과에 큰 영향을 주는지 확인할 수 있습니다.
/ko/case-value-calculator.linkLabel: 사건 가치와 합의에 관한 질문 보기 (영어)

/es/blogs.title: Siga una pregunta por vez en la biblioteca
paragraphs: Busque primero la guía que responde a lo más urgente. Si espera un informe, le será más útil un artículo distinto del que necesita alguien que revisa una oferta. Tenga el documento y su número de reclamo a mano. Cuando surja otra pregunta sobre cobertura, plazos o culpa, siga la guía relacionada.
/es/blogs.linkLabel: Explore la biblioteca de recursos (en inglés)

/ko/blogs.title: 기사에서 한 가지 질문부터 해결하세요
paragraphs: 가장 급한 질문에 답하는 안내부터 찾으세요. 보고서를 기다리는 경우와 합의 제안을 검토하는 경우에 필요한 기사는 다릅니다. 해당 서류와 청구 번호를 곁에 두고 읽으세요. 보험 보장, 기한, 과실에 관한 다른 질문이 생기면 관련 안내에서 이어서 확인하세요.
